topic_title: Establishing a Safe Following Interval (3-Sec Rule)
prompt: When stopped behind a motorcycle at a red light, how much space buffer should you maintain?

options.text: Within eighteen inches of the rear motorcycle tire to maximize road capacity
Two inches from the motorcycle exhaust pipe to keep traffic flowing compact
Pull directly abreast of the motorcycle inside the same lane at crosswalk
A full vehicle length buffer to prevent pushing rider into traffic if struck
